source_selection_policy.method: highest Smart Bidding ROI on the operational date at manifest preflight, restricted to the same vehicle type
source_selection_policy.roi_source: Smart Bidding Reports > Adgroup; USD; Discount revenue share enabled
source_selection_policy.vehicle_partition: MOTO requires a source campaign whose name contains the whole token MOTO; CARRO excludes MOTO campaigns
source_selection_policy.candidate_gates: same ad account, non-terminal MAXVOL campaign, positive Smart Bidding investment, one non-terminal OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS adset and one unambiguous AD01/AD02/AD03 source set
source_selection_policy.tie_breaker: higher ROI, then higher investment, then stable campaign ID
source_selection_policy.fallback: fail closed before reservation/write when no eligible same-vehicle ROI source exists; never cross CARRO and MOTO and never default to C08
source_selection_policy.persistence: persist source campaign/adset/ad IDs, ROI, investment, revenue, date, currency, formula and source snapshot digest before manifest sealing
source_selection_policy.historical_scope: does not rewrite or recreate completed C28-C30, whose audited source remains C08

campaign_creation_taxonomy.from_zero_prestaged: criação do zero: campanha, conjunto, creatives e anúncios novos; usa criativos novos
campaign_creation_taxonomy.clone_prestaged: clone com criativos novos: a estrutura vem da melhor fonte elegível da mesma vertical, mas os três creatives/posts são substituídos por assets novos do Drive
campaign_creation_taxonomy.pure_clone: duplicação igual: copiar a campanha vencedora sem trocar mídia, copy, estrutura, público, estratégia ou budget; usar o próximo número sequencial e reescrever somente naming e link/UTMs para o novo número, além dos novos IDs técnicos inevitáveis
campaign_creation_taxonomy.selection_rule: the natural-language request selects exactly one mode; never infer pure_clone from the word clone when the request also asks for new Drive creatives, and never replace source creatives when Rodolfo asks to duplicate the campaign identically
campaign_creation_taxonomy.performance_rule: when the request says best campaign, recompute the eligible winner at manifest preflight inside CARRO or MOTO; no campaign ID becomes a permanent template
campaign_creation_taxonomy.learning_caveat: pure_clone preserves source media and copy but campaign/adset are new delivery objects; changing URL tags may rematerialize the Creative ID and preservation of the same post/story is confirmed only by effective_object_story_id; similar performance is empirical, not guaranteed by Meta

tracking_mutations.source_example: duplicating C10 into the next free sequential slot creates C11
tracking_mutations.change: campaign/adset canonical names, target number, utm_campaign, utm_adgroup and final click tracking change from source cN to target cN
tracking_mutations.preserve: base URL, all non-UTM parameters, media, Meta copy fields, campaign/adset structure, audience, placements, event, bid strategy and budget
tracking_mutations.lineage: persist source_campaign_id, immediate source campaign number and target campaign number in manifest/state/audit
tracking_mutations.visible_lineage_marker: append the exact suffix COPY C{immediate_source_number} to the duplicated campaign name; never use DUP
tracking_mutations.visible_example: a new C11 duplicated directly from C10 ends with COPY C10
tracking_mutations.readback: confirm target number and names, exact final URLs/UTMs on every ad, unchanged media/copy equivalence and effective_object_story_id when Meta technically preserves the same post; do not require Creative ID equality

from_zero_policy: explicit campaign_create and adset_create payloads; no source campaign, adset or ad IDs; campaign, adset, creatives and ads are new objects; reference readback may supply compliant field values but is never copied
account_budget_envelope: dynamic=max(USD500 floor, live configured-active budget + exact authorized creation/scale/reactivation deltas)
transient_code2_retry_policy: separate write/recovery/readback reservations; remaining effective capacity decides retry timing; a fresh recovery reservation that covers targeted GETs, missing children, required normalization and final readback completes in one wave
readback: after a two-campaign write window, persist all IDs, wait the live header reset or 305 seconds, then run one consolidated Graph batch without replaying writes
recovery_after_partial_write: when missing children are created during recovery, persist every resolved ID, return READBACK_DEFERRED with a fresh cooldown and perform only consolidated readback on the next resume; never read back in the same quota window
resume_scheduler: every minute with retry_after_epoch gate and nonblocking flock; no in-process cooldown sleep; the general creation hold and job enabled state remain independent
media_gate: three ready assets per campaign in v3 media registry before manifest; planner chunks 1-100 campaigns into bundles of two
ad_naming_gate: every asset_ref requires canonical_filename; ad=AD NN - canonical stem; creative=CPV CNN ADNN canonical stem; asset_id is forbidden as display name
first_delivery_postprocess: after validated hierarchy readback, every production campaign is auto-allowlisted and armed in the 15-minute watcher; first spend observed 00:30-02:00 SP releases without pause, later first spend pauses once and queues next-day 00:30 reactivation
first_delivery_fail_closed: campaign completion remains POSTPROCESS_PENDING until watcher enrollment returns exact campaign IDs, armed count and meta_writes=0
daily_state_rollover: a completed operational date is never reused as the next day's resumable request; the next 17:00 cycle starts with a fresh request and fresh Drive-Meta reconciliation
failure_reporting: operator-visible errors identify the affected scheduled campaigns and include stage, cause, consequence, correction in progress and useful recovery status without internal paths or credentials
failure_write_gate: reaffirmed on 2026-08-27 by Rodolfo Mattei: an error never ends in passive blocking; Ares must diagnose, read back actual state, correct only the missing or invalid layer of the same authorized request and continue until completion without blind replay or scope expansion

automatic_failure_recovery.scope: all failures inside an already authorized Creative Ops or Campaign Ops request
automatic_failure_recovery.required_behavior: diagnose, reconcile, correct and continue until the requested operation is concluded
automatic_failure_recovery.external_blocker_behavior: keep the request resumable and actively escalated with exact cause and next action; never mark it concluded or abandon it because an error was reported

budget_reporting: every completed scheduled creation reports active account budget, effective dynamic envelope and remaining USD inside that envelope from live Meta preflight plus validated budgets created by the request
creation_lifecycle_gate: new campaigns are not an unconditional daily output; analyze D1-D3, apply approved pause/scale actions and create a new cohort only when the lifecycle review justifies it and Rodolfo or Nicolas releases the creation hold
current_creation_hold: general daily creation hold is active; one-time request cpv-c26-c28-20260826 completed C26, C27 and C28 for delivery on 2026-08-27 and did not release future creation
write_gate: config.enabled=true and config.write_enabled=true plus --confirm-execute from an authorized campaign request
first_production_request: guarded canary automatically: prevalidated manifest, first bundle monitored, fail closed on any drift

authorization.scope: build, install and activate v3 as the production route under development_access guards; no campaign object requested by this activation
